_comment: WRITE MODEL: single-writer, signed-artifact-only. This file is never edited by hand or by routine code -- it is replaced wholesale by the release process each time a key is revoked, signed by R-INTENTOPS, and republished. A clone caches its own copy and refuses (never silently accepts) any file whose `sequence` is lower than the cached one (rollback protection, trust-root-design.md sect. 8.2). Today this file carries no signature because nothing has been revoked and no root has been minted (see config/trust-roots.yaml) -- `signature` is null rather than omitted, so the absence is a visible fact instead of a missing field.

_entry_schema.key_id: first 16 hex chars of the revoked key's fingerprint
_entry_schema.fingerprint: sha256:<64hex> of the revoked key, full form
_entry_schema.advisory: path or URL to the human-readable advisory naming what happened
